author: Shrimpy
body:
First and foremost, I am NOT doing this nor do I plan to since that would be a waste of money and time. But if I or some user got banned from Avicus and returned with an alt, would that be against the rules and considered ban-evading? I'm just curious.

Warm regards,
TheBron_cool
body_tagged:
First and foremost, I am NOT doing this nor do I plan to since that would be a waste of money and time. But if I or some user got banned from Avicus and returned with an alt, would that be against the rules and considered ban-evading? I'm just curious.

Warm regards,
TheBron_cool
title: Bad to use alts if banned?

replies.author: ProfessorUtonium
replies.body: Yes it is.
replies.body_tagged: Yes it is.

replies.author: Tarheelkiwi
replies.body: Yes.  Yes it is
replies.body_tagged: Yes.  Yes it is

replies.author: Emmaye
replies.body: Yes, it's not allowed, which is typically Ban Evading.
replies.body_tagged: Yes, it's not allowed, which is typically Ban Evading.

replies.author: kycrafft
replies.body: This applies with tempbans too, just so you know.
replies.body_tagged: This applies with tempbans too, just so you know.

replies.author: TheMasterClock
replies.body: Yes, as kycrafft said above, Ban Evading also is with Temp-Bans.
replies.body_tagged: Yes, as kycrafft said above, Ban Evading also is with Temp-Bans.

replies.author: Splades
replies.body: Not saying I haven't done it before, but yes that would be considered ban evading. You must appeal at support@avicus.net to be unbanned.
replies.body_tagged: Not saying I haven't done it before, but yes that would be considered ban evading. You must appeal at support@avicus.net to be unbanned.

replies.author: Out2Kill
replies.body: But how would you find out?
replies.body_tagged: But how would you find out?

replies.author: Eklip_Z
replies.body: Usually you can find out by tracking each players ip. If two players ip match it usually means that they are being used in the same location which is how you can find out. If a player is using a VPN (virtual private network) this method doesn't really work.
